evidence.quote: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans. On all other plans, you'll still have access to a limited set of free test queries.
You'll need an API key to send requests via Ahrefs API v3. Provide it in the Authorization header when making requests: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.
Ahrefs API ... allows you to pull data ... endpoints, as well as manage your Rank Tracker projects and Keywords Explorer lists.
Connect your Ahrefs data to AI assistants and agents to enhance their answers with real marketing insights.

output.one_liner: Ahrefs provides a paid‑plan API (v3) that lets developers query SEO and marketing data such as site explorer, keyword metrics, rank tracking, and more via HTTP endpoints.
output.access_note: API is available on eligible paid plans; other plans only get limited free test queries.
output.blocker: Requires a paid Ahrefs subscription for most endpoints and consumes API units.
